mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing inflationary pressure and increasing the likelihood of future monetary policy easing, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 1,700,000 units in two consecutive months signals weakening household demand for housing, which correlates with reduced consumer spending and lower future corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the risk of recession and triggers equity market risk-off behavior, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year and FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signal a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts below 1,700,000 units and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 670,000 million dollars signals a broad-based weakening in household demand, which increases the probability of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal does not outperform individual proxies in out-of-sample Rank IC (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth above 250,000 jobs per month combined with a declining unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 670,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, combined with a stagnating GDP growth rate (GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized), indicates a weakening demand environment that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to achieve a Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.
